verdict.rationale: Gram ships an official CLI (verified runnable via runtime probe) that can build/publish MCP servers and toolsets, which supports CI/headless automation, and docs confirm a working command-line reference. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, no GitHub Actions example, and no headless auth/service-account guidance for unattended runs. Missing for 10: documented CI examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/pipeline configs), non-interactive/service-account authentication flow for the CLI, and independent hands-on confirmation of full automation beyond version-check.
